AFWD.chosen_element: a declarative sentence that advances the exposition from one concept to the next
AFWD.justification: each forward morphism carries the reader from a defined token to its logical consequence, building the architecture section by section

AREV.chosen_element: the editorial act of retracing a line of reasoning to revisit a branching point
AREV.justification: contravariant motion; the argument descends from a developed idea back to the fork where alternative paths began, enabling full coverage of the three threads

CLINK.chosen_element: a chain of lemmas connected by explicit 'therefore' links
CLINK.justification: composition of morphisms; each lemma feeds its output as input to the next, forming a continuous proof strand without gaps

ENGAGR.chosen_element: the kernel proof section where the document simultaneously asserts closure and acknowledges that any formal system reflects an infinite regress
ENGAGR.justification: both true and false are held without resolution; the proofs show necessity and sufficiency while conceding that self-reference introduces an irresolvable paradice

EVALF.chosen_element: the branch labeled 'Derived Gates' that explores what lies outside the primitive set by constructing NOT, AND, OR from the dialetheia tokens
EVALF.justification: the negative space: any grammar that lacks these derived combinators would be incomplete, so the path affirms the primitives by testing their limit through negation

EVALT.chosen_element: the branch labeled 'Affirmative Definition' where every opcode is presented as correct and complete
EVALT.justification: the positive valuation: the path accepts the twelve-opcode grammar unconditionally and develops its semantics without reservation

FFUSE.chosen_element: the final synthesis chapter 'When Everything Is Counted' that weaves the three strands back into a single conclusion
FFUSE.justification: multiplication; the arguments reunite and exactly reconstitute the original undivided thesis, demonstrating that the split covered the whole space

FSPLIT.chosen_element: the subsection heading 'Branched Derivations' that partitions the text into three parallel expositions
FSPLIT.justification: co-multiplication: a single thesis statement divides into three distinct but co-dependent lines—opcode definitions, gate constructions, and kernel proofs—each pursued independently

IFIX.chosen_element: the cryptographic hash of the typeset PDF registered in a timestamped public ledger
IFIX.justification: permanent, append-only fixation; once the document is sealed its state cannot be altered, creating a definitive record of the grammar at a point in time

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: the sentence, 'This very sentence is an instance of IMSCRIB,' appearing in the definition of the identity token
IMSCRIB.justification: self-reference; the document recognizes that it is itself a structure built from the twelve opcodes and so must contain its own image

TANCH.chosen_element: the terminal double rule drawn after the concluding paragraph
TANCH.justification: seals the system by marking the outermost boundary; no token, morphism, or proof may extend beyond this anchor

VINIT.chosen_element: the blank page before any text is committed
VINIT.justification: the writing surface exists but holds no symbol, no name, no state—it is the uninitialized void from which the document emerges

phase_2.fuse_element: the synthesis chapter 'When Everything Is Counted'
phase_2.fuse_result: the thesis statement again, now fully justified: the grammar holds everything that can be counted, and it counts itself
phase_2.split_input: the thesis statement: 'What holds when everything is counted is the twelve-opcode grammar itself.'

phase_3.both_description: the state where the grammar claims completeness even as it admits that self-reference prevents absolute closure, holding both claims simultaneously

phase_3.true_description: the validated grammar where all twelve opcodes align, all three gates reduce, and all kernel proofs converge without contradiction
phase_3.void_description: the uninitialized document: zero characters, no layout, no signal—pure potential before any naming

steps.domain_action: the writing surface is empty, unmarked, a pure uninitialized plane
the author lays down the title 'What Holds When Everything Is Counted'
the title bends back on itself, acknowledging that the document is an object of the very grammar it will unfold
the text forks into three parallel sections under the heading 'Branched Derivations'
the narrative commits to the opcode definitions branch as the affirmative axis
VINIT is defined as the genesis token, the void from which all symbols spring
TANCH is chained to VINIT, establishing the terminal boundary that will enclose the whole
AFWD is defined as the forward morphism, the directional act of moving one step ahead
AREV is defined as the contravariant morphism, the ability to retrace a step
CLINK is defined by composing two AFWDs into a single unbroken chain
IMSCRIB is defined, and the definition paragraph includes the very sentence 'This sentence is an IMSCRIB instance'
FSPLIT is defined by splitting the definition itself from the main text into a sub-clause
FFUSE is defined by promising that the upcoming synthesis will return to the original undivided statement
EVALT and EVALF are defined as the true and false valuations that anchor a split
ENGAGR is defined as the token that holds truth and falsity in un-collapsed conjunction
IFIX is defined as the irreversible commit, the final fixed inscription
the exposition backtracks to the fork point after completing the opcode catalog
the gate construction branch is taken as the negative space of derived operators
the AND gate is built by chaining EVALT with EVALF inside a single split so that both conditions must hold
the OR gate is assembled by nesting splits so that any positive arm propagates through
the NOT gate is formed by inverting the roles of EVALT and EVALF on a trivial fork, completing the set of three derived gates
the exposition returns again to the fork point after the gate section
the kernel proof branch is entered, holding certainty and doubt together
Lemma I proves that every token is necessary; removing any one breaks closure
Lemma II proves sufficiency, showing that any formal operation factorizes through the twelve
the self-consistency proof deploys an IMSCRIB that matches the outer document, demonstrating that no external axioms are needed
the narrative returns to the branch point after the proofs
the synthesis section 'When Everything Is Counted' fuses the three strands, reconstituting the original thesis with full substantiation
the closing paragraph draws the conclusion: the grammar holds everything that can be counted, and it counts itself
the double rule is drawn, sealing the document's boundary
the sealed document is hashed and anchored to an immutable ledger, its state forever fixed

phase_5.memory_mechanism: the paper or persistent file that stores the entire document state across time

phase_6.cycle_cost: cognitive energy spent in generating or parsing each token of the document
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the total information content of the grammar is conserved; the document neither creates nor destroys meaning, only transduces it from written form to understanding
phase_6.post_cycle_state: the fully assimilated grammar, now residing as an activated mental structure in the reader
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: the uninterpreted document, full of potential meaning but not yet processed by a reader
